hikes.name: Lower Table Rock
hikes.blurb: Up an old lava-capped mesa to spring wildflowers, vernal pools and cliffs high over the Rogue.

hikes.name: Upper Table Rock
hikes.blurb: The shorter climb onto the other Table Rock, a horseshoe-shaped plateau over the valley.

hikes.name: Pilot Rock
hikes.blurb: A short, steep scramble to the top of a basalt plug standing over the California border, Shasta to the south.

hikes.name: Grizzly Peak
hikes.blurb: Through a regrowing burn to meadows and a view over Ashland to Mt Ashland and Shasta.

hikes.name: Wagner Butte
hikes.blurb: A long climb through meadows and springs to a rocky old lookout site high in the Siskiyous.

hikes.name: Hobart Bluff
hikes.blurb: An easy stretch of the Pacific Crest Trail to a cliff over the Ashland valley.

hikes.name: Natural Bridge and Rogue Gorge
hikes.blurb: Where the Rogue River vanishes into a lava tube and bursts out again downstream.

hikes.name: Mount Ashland
hikes.blurb: From Bull Gap Trailhead, a 5.8-mile round trip to the top of Mount Ashland (7,486 ft), with about 2,050 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Siskiyou Gap
hikes.blurb: From Wrangle Gap Trailhead, a 7.5-mile round trip to Siskiyou Gap, with about 1,350 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Dutchman Peak
hikes.blurb: From Wrangle Gap Trailhead, an 8.3-mile round trip to the top of Dutchman Peak (7,423 ft), with about 1,250 feet of climbing.
